newsitem.title: JAPAN: Michinoku Bank to issue new shares.
newsitem.headline: Michinoku Bank to issue new shares.

text.p: Aomori-based Michinoku Bank Ltd said on Monday that it would issue 14.17 million new shares to its shareholders.
The regional bank said in a statement that it would allocate a tenth of a new share for each existing share.
After the new share issue, the bank's capital adequacy ratio will rise about 0.5 percentage point, the bank said.
The new shares would be offered at 420 yen per share and the payment made on December 27, it said.
The bank's share price closed up 10 yen at 870 yen on Monday.
